topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The earth gave something back today, a chest not of our making. It’s hard, this thing, different from the clods we turn each season. The metal spoke of secrets, of days long past when it was put down here. We’ve tilled this soil for more years than I can count, and such a thing was never known to us. The saints, they must be watching, for a reason must be behind this unearthing. I fear to open it, to disturb what lies within. Better to leave it be, and pray that whatever was meant to stay buried, stays that way. The fields know their secrets, and some are best left untouched.
